title: Original RAX project articulated air-fryer viewer, packaged for offline presentation
geometry_or_model_changes: None. Original point clouds, measured model parameters, fitted rim, action poses, camera setup and interpolation logic retained.
packaging_changes: Convert ES module transport into isolated classic-script bundles for file://
Embed original JSON instead of fetch
White slide-sized layout; Source Sans 3 font embedded
Retain drawer slider, point-cloud/model/pose toggles, orbit, zoom and original first-view opening animation
Add reset-view/auto-rotate buttons and a presentation pause/resume API
Any slider input cancels the introductory opening animation immediately, including keyboard/programmatic input.
measurement_note: The model drawer slides continuously; point clouds switch between the original recorded closed/open observations at the same threshold used on the official site. Planned poses appear near the measured maximum opening.

license_status.three_js_and_OrbitControls: MIT, verified from three@0.160.0/LICENSE; included in THREE-LICENSE.txt and HTML comment
license_status.source_fonts: SIL Open Font License 1.1; parent package includes original licenses under assets/fonts/
license_status.RAX_viewer_and_data: No explicit viewer/data license was found in the downloaded scripts or project page. Original attribution and source URLs are retained here; no broader license is asserted.

verification.browser: Chromium, offline file://, both standalone and parent iframe
verification.early_input: Slider set approximately 655 ms after load; held 131 mm after 1200 ms across the introductory animation window.
verification.parent_visibility: False stops rendered-frame counter and camera movement; true resumes rendering.
